create.name: Christian de la Huerta
create.bio:
Christian de la Huerta is a Cuban-born breathwork teacher, coach and author who founded Soulful Power. His family left Havana for the United States when he was ten. In his late twenties, with a comfortable career in South Florida behind him, a single breathwork session turned him towards an inner search; he set aside plans for a doctorate in psychology and spent about five years on his own spiritual work before beginning to guide others, which he has now done for more than thirty years.

His approach pairs a method he calls Soulful Breathwork with coaching and teaching on personal power, purpose and relationships. He runs regular group breath sessions in the Miami area, weekend retreats in Miami and in Woodacre, California, a year-long online group coaching programme and a training for people who want to facilitate breathwork themselves, and he has given a TEDx talk on the breath. His books are Coming Out Spiritually, an early study of spirituality in LGBTQ lives that Publishers Weekly placed among the best religion titles of its year; Awakening the Soul of Power, the first volume of his Calling All Heroes series; and Conscious Love, on how unexamined patterns shape our closest bonds.

books.title: Conscious Love: Transforming Our Relationship to Relationships
books.author: Christian de la Huerta
books.description: His most recent book looks at the beliefs and habits people bring into partnership without noticing. It names common reasons relationships falter and offers spiritual and psychological practices for loving with more awareness.

books.title: Awakening the Soul of Power
books.author: Christian de la Huerta
books.description: The opening book of his Calling All Heroes series reconsiders what heroism and personal power can mean today. It sets out practices for standing in one's own authority without force.

books.title: Coming Out Spiritually: The Next Step
books.author: Christian de la Huerta
books.description: An early exploration of the spiritual roles and archetypes found among gay and lesbian people across traditions. It invites LGBTQ readers to reclaim a spiritual life on their own terms.

courses.title: Soulful Relationships Retreat (Miami, February 2027)
courses.description: A four-day non-residential retreat at Santuario de la Paz in Miami for singles and couples. Days combine his teaching on relationship patterns, group coaching and Soulful Breathwork sessions.

courses.title: Soulful Coaching
courses.description: Coaching with Christian, either in Adventures in Transformation, a twelve-month online group programme, or in private sessions of one hour or three hours with breathwork, online or in person.

courses.title: Soulful Breathwork Facilitator Training
courses.description: A training for people who want to lead breathwork groups in his method. Students learn in a small cohort with personal guidance from Christian.

free_resources.title: Free guided meditation and sample chapter
free_resources.description: Sign up on his site to receive a guided meditation, some short practices and a sample chapter from Awakening the Soul of Power.
